course_name_original: Gender und Diversity: Erfolgsfaktoren für Unternehmen (3135)
course_name_en: Gender and Diversity: Success Factors for Companies

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the terms Gender, Gender Mainstreaming as well as Diversity and Diversity Management, their history and differences.
Students know legal foundations in the context of gender and diversity (e.g. EU Anti-Discrimination Directive, General Equal Treatment Act AGG).
Students are sensitized to human heterogeneity in the corporate context.
Students independently recognize stereotyping and can develop ideas for change possibilities in the corporate environment.
Students are able to independently collect relevant information on established concepts such as Gender Mainstreaming and Diversity Management and assess their relevance for professional practice.

Students know selected theories and approaches in the current discourse on Diversity Management and can, building on this, develop concept ideas for the implementation of holistic Diversity Management in the corporate context.

syllabus_topics: Definition of terms and demarcation of gender and diversity
Concepts and approaches to equal opportunities (e.g. Diversity Management, Gender Mainstreaming)
Legal foundations and political influences (e.g. EU Anti-Discrimination Directive, General Equal Treatment Act AGG)
Subjective and societal values, attitudes and prejudices in the context of diversity
Possible approaches for considering selected diversity characteristics (e.g. gender and age) in selected corporate areas (Marketing, Product Development, Human Resources)
Concept for the sustainable introduction of holistic Diversity Management
Case studies and application examples from corporate practice
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
